evidence.observation: 6.5 ppm at growth start, consistent with ramp baseline ~4-8 ppm
Rose steadily 12.3→16.2→19.5→25.7 ppm over growth, roughly 4x baseline, with no sign of leveling off
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not from a change in purge flow
Holding 750 °C with normal heater power; thermal control looks normal
Pressure gauge not installed; growth-stage atmosphere cannot be verified as the protocol requires

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading (or a leak-up / pressure-hold test) would separate a seal leak from other causes of oxygen getting in. No normal-run reference values were given for comparison.
